definitions.explanation: A quality of gentleness, kindness, or emotional warmth that a person, thing, or atmosphere possesses. Often refers to an intangible feeling of comfort or human connection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{温|あたた}かみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Homemade cooking has a warm touch to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{温|あたた}かみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{感|かん}じられた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I could feel warmth in his words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧{温|あたた}かみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかく→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Wooden furniture has a warmth that metal lacks, and it softens the atmosphere of a room.

notes:
Formed from the i-adjective ⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧ + the suffix み, which converts adjectives into nouns expressing the quality or feeling of that adjective. Unlike {温|あたた}かさ (which measures degree of warmth), {温|あたた}かみ emphasizes the subjective, emotional quality — a sense of gentleness, comfort, or human touch.

Primarily used for emotional or aesthetic warmth rather than physical temperature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温|あたた}かみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have warmth; to feel warm
- {温|あたた}かみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel warmth
- {温|あたた}かみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: a warm voice
- {温|あたた}かみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: a warm color
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{温|あたた}かみ: human warmth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {温|あたた}かさ: warmth (degree) — more objective, can refer to physical temperature
- {優|やさ}しさ: kindness; gentleness — focuses on character rather than atmosphere
- ぬくもり: warmth; coziness — more physical and intimate, often body warmth or the warmth of being held
